title: TSMC September 2026 Revenue NT$511.86B, +54.6% YoY; Q3 Record NT$1.494T Exceeds Guidance
summary: TSMC September 2026 monthly revenue reached NT$511.86 billion, up 54.6% year-on-year. Q3 2026 cumulative revenue hit a record NT$1.494 trillion, exceeding the company's guidance range, driven by strong AI infrastructure chip demand. Full Q3 earnings are scheduled for October 15.
why: 台积电九月单月营收同比+54.6%，Q3整季收入历史新高并超指引，是本周最关键的半导体基本面催化剂；10月15日Q3正式财报将影响英伟达、美光、SK海力士等供应链及相关sell-put行权价定价；本条10月8日发布（距今3天），Q3完整财报尚未公布，故标记still_developing。本轮为周日休市日，大盘头条新闻量有限，仅纳入具官方信源或白名单媒体佐证的条目，当日重大头条偏少。

title: Nvidia Commits $1 Billion to Advance US Science Over Five Years via Genesis Mission
summary: Nvidia pledged $1 billion over the next five years to advance US science through the Genesis Mission, covering quantum computing and scientific infrastructure, announced by CEO Jensen Huang on October 8, 2026.
why: 英伟达以十亿美元官方承诺支持美国国家科学生态（量子计算、科研基础设施），与同日AI概念股普跌（OpenAI营收报道引发sell-off）形成正面反差，表明英伟达管理层对中长期AI需求高度信心；对英伟达sell-put策略的行权价保护具参考价值；官方IR新闻稿为primary_official已验证信源。10月8日发布（距今3天），五年期承诺仍处执行起步阶段，故标记still_developing。
